en.headline: Weekend outlook: showers and thunderstorms easing, then hotter days return
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory expects occasional showers and squally thunderstorms to continue into Saturday before sunny intervals and very hot conditions develop early next week.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a band of intense thundery showers associated with upper-air disturbances and a southwesterly airstream is affecting Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea. Friday remains mainly cloudy with occasional showers and severe squally thunderstorms, heavy at times, under moderate southwesterly winds.

For Saturday, the Observatory anticipates still more showers in some areas at first, with sunny intervals during the day. Temperatures are expected to range from about 27 to 32 degrees Celsius. Sunday should bring sunny periods and one or two showers, with urban highs around 33 degrees and very hot conditions returning.

Looking further ahead, the upper-air disturbances are expected to depart, leaving very hot weather during the day over the coast of Guangdong early next week, though a few showers will persist. A broad trough of low pressure may edge closer to the coast later in the week. Members of the public were advised to stay alert to the latest warnings, which on Friday morning included the Amber Rainstorm Warning and Thunderstorm Warning.

zh.headline: 週末天氣展望：驟雨雷暴逐漸減少 下周初回復酷熱
zh.dek: 天文台預料周六初時部分地區仍有較多驟雨及雷暴，日間短暫陽光；周日起日間酷熱，但仍有幾陣驟雨。
body: 天文台表示，與高空擾動及西南氣流相關的強烈雷雨帶正影響廣東及南海北部。今日（周五）大致多雲，間中有驟雨及狂風雷暴，初時雨勢有時頗大，吹和緩西南風。
周六初時部分地區驟雨仍然較多及有雷暴，日間短暫時間有陽光，氣溫約27至32度。周日短暫時間有陽光，有一兩陣驟雨，日間酷熱，市區最高氣溫約33度。
展望下周初高空擾動遠離後，廣東沿岸日間酷熱，但仍有幾陣驟雨。中後期南海北部至台灣以東海面的闊廣低壓槽或逐漸靠近廣東沿岸。市民應留意最新天氣警告，周五上午曾發出黃色暴雨警告及雷暴警告。
